correctness.rationale: The exact raw volume identity is proved from real normalized Fourier eigenvectors, independent spectral Vandermonde demixing and the codimension-one cofactor transform. The coefficient vector is exactly the first Lagrange interpolation polynomial. Singular cases follow from rank or continuity. The arithmetic observability iff condition and complete five-mode discrete optimizer rule follow by exact divisibility and unimodality, with a Taylor bound proving D-optimal/demixed-condition divergence for every 6-divisible \(N\ge42\). The included checker independently cross-checks 801 raw Gram volumes, 496 all-grid optimizations and 78 metric-divergence cases; its finite samples are not the proof.

value.rationale: A universal structural factorization for the untreated space-time information volume is a natural design invariant across all low-pass dimensions and all separating real evolutions. The five-mode exact two-candidate rule and sharp nonattained limiting envelope solve a concrete natural sensor-location problem; the proven discrepancy with demixed-conditioning placements establishes a nontrivial and useful boundary between two graph sampling objectives. It does not assert a noise-MSE theorem or general multi-sensor result.
